dedicated_fresh_reload_restart.note: Earlier baseline; 1.1.0 server-side regression uses GameTests with and without Better Combat.

generated_trails.thrusts: Crossed tip wakes for detected stabs; unchanged from 1.0.4
generated_trails.native_duplicate_suppression: passed, including opt-out and disabled-trail fallback
generated_trails.blade_tracking: Captured 3D origins/tips; emitted vertices checked against real samples
generated_trails.elemental_geometry: All built-in styles use generated geometry
generated_trails.elemental_color: Configured color is independent of physical enchantment tint

strike_timing.source: Contiguous substantial arm/item/torso keyframes with contact preference; no explicit damage-phase marker in Better Combat
strike_timing.windup: No emission outside the detected interval
strike_timing.recovery: Boundary-clipped geometry only; no new recovery strokes or accents
strike_timing.speed_source: Fastest captured endpoint across all emitters; latched for the strike
strike_timing.interframe_boundaries: Clipped at entry and exit, including post-end animation clock
strike_timing.two_pose_mesh: passed for slash, blunt and stab geometry
strike_timing.capacity: Generated strokes retain first/current endpoints under per-trail cap; global budgets still apply
strike_timing.explicit_animation_windows: Override automatic estimate; starting speed gate still applies

multi_emitter_geometry.fire_aspect_geometry: Matches every base emitter sample and preserves element color
